title: Corey A I
style: Comedy phonk-pop with bouncy half-time drums, rubbery bass pulses, beatbox pockets, and playful gang-vocal callbacks; verse runs like a cheeky talk-sung cipher, pre-chorus tightens with filtered claps and harmonic lifts, chorus pops with stacked family-style harmonies and Spanish licks. Ad-lib pings, reverse swells, mouth-percussion fills; bright punchy mix, glossy and wide., comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Corey:
A I, eye, eye sees all

Michelle:
Oi, that bloke looks cooked

Ruby:
Mira, mira, he’s in a loop

Wesley:
He tripped on his own shoelace, bro

[Verse 1]
Corey:
I’m in the shed with a plan so sharp
Blueprints spread like cards at the park
One little chip, one cheeky grin
Made the ute think, then I let it in

Michelle:
He’s got that look, “I know the score”
Then he forgets where he left the door
Pink drink slurped in a servo cup
“Mate, that’s science” — “Yeah, yeah, shut up”

Ruby:
I said “hola” to the broken drone
It came back home like it missed its tone
Mi cabeza’s fast, my feet go splat
Still I can spot a sneaky rat

Wesley:
He’s got that panther move, real local style
Slidin’ through Brighton with a childish smile
If the seagulls shuck, he ducks and waves
Then he does a beatbox with two gum leaves

[Pre-Chorus]
Corey:
Corey A I eye, eye sees all
Big brain bounce, don’t hit that wall

Michelle:
Hold that thought, let it spin, let it glow
He’s two steps ahead, and you know, you know

Ruby:
Ay, ay, qué loco
Wesley:
Bruv, that’s a joke-o

[Chorus]
Corey A I eye
Eye sees all
Corey A I eye
Catch that call

Michelle:
Pink cup, slick move
We all lean in
Corey A I eye
Let the fun begin

Ruby:
Ay, Core-y
Wesley:
Oi, Core-y
All:
Corey A I eye, eye, eye

[Verse 2]
Michelle:
He built a box from a busted fan
Now it talks back like a disco man
“Who left chips on the motherboard?”
“Not me, babe” — then the whole room roared

Corey:
I mapped the mess with a grin and a glance
Spun it like salsa, gave logic a dance
Sydney slang on the tip of my tongue
Two-word punch and the beatbox rung

Ruby:
I’m little but loud, I’m quick, I’m sly
I see the treats when they pass me by
“Por favor” if you want my share
I’ll take the front seat, I’ll take the air

Wesley:
Wes got the bounce and the runaway feet
Tap-tap, clap-clap, on the backstreet beat
Mum said “clean up” — I said “all good”
Then I hid the evidence under the hood

[Bridge]
Michelle:
Wait, who made the plan?
Corey:
Me, with a wink

Ruby:
Who found the clue?
Wesley:
Mate, too quick to think

All:
Mira, mira
Oi, oi
Big brain, small trouble
Big joy, big noise

[Chorus]
Corey A I eye
Eye sees all
Corey A I eye
Catch that call

Michelle:
Pink cup, slick move
We all lean in
Corey A I eye
Let the fun begin

Ruby:
Ay, ay
